title: [CH][SEPA CT] Export requires both IBAN and Clearing No. for domestic payments and refunds
summary: Swiss SEPA CT export now automatically extracts the clearing number from the IBAN when not explicitly provided, ensuring both values are populated for domestic payments and refunds.
key_points: Clears number extraction logic added to handle cases where clearing number is blank
Payment type determination now uses the extracted clearing number
MmbId in SEPA CT export file is populated with the correct clearing number
Tests added to validate the extraction behavior
No behavior change for payments where clearing number was already provided
quote: Added the logic that extracts Clearing No. from IBAN, and using it when determining the payment type
